## Re-measurement at source, replacing the deleted triage comment

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat · session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S` · 2026-09-24T05:49Z · objectui `origin/main` `62597c5` · read with `git show` / `git grep` on `origin/main`, never the working tree. Maintainer instruction in this seat's session, verbatim: 「这些卡你自己分析和排查一下」.

⚠️ The clone is shallow: its oldest commit is `8ed4b95` at 2026-09-20T12:48Z, so commits between filing and that instant are not visible. ⛔ Grading and routing stay with the triage seat; this comment supplies evidence only.

**Verdict: CONFIRMED, and the governing ruling has since landed and missed all three.**

- Still `string | number`: `packages/types/src/views.ts:555` `CommentSearchResult.recordId` (required), `views.ts:731` `RecordSubscription.recordId` (required), and `types/src/data.ts:1315` `DataSourceMutationEvent.id?`. Lit control: `CommentEntry.recordId?: string` (`views.ts:515`) and `MentionNotification.recordId?: string` (`:537`) are already narrowed.
- Ruling: director batch #195 item 1 letter A (comment `5749154869`, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-20T10:11Z). It was executed by PR objectui#10141 (`87af769`, closes objectui#9511, `Clause-②: yes`), which landed after this card was filed and edited the same two files, but none of the three. Grepping these names in its tests and `.changeset` gives 0 hits; lit control: `recordId` hits in `authorable-record-id-string-9511.test.ts`.
- All three are published exports (`types/src/index.ts:390,926,934`). Consumers: `collaboration/useCommentSearch.ts`, plugin-detail (SubscriptionToggle, RecordChatterPanel, RecordActivityTimeline), `core/adapters/ValueDataSource.ts` and `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`.
- Class: contract/type hygiene. Whether ruling A reaches these three is triage/director to say. The fix narrows published types, which is breaking for callers passing numbers, like #10141. Per the lane rule narrowing is ⛔ not Clause-②, so the seat would declare `yes` on the #10141 precedent. Size S–M.

Serial constraints cleared: re-measured on objectui `origin/main` `f9c06ef6a`. Of the 7 open non-release PRs, none touches `views.ts` or `data.ts`. PR objectui#10710 edits `packages/types/src/index.ts` and `objectql.ts`, which are outside this surface. Among live `pm:dispatched` claims, objectui#10657 names `plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` and objectui#10712 / objectui#10682 name `plugin-form`, so no file is shared. objectui#10611 (same lane) also edits `views.ts` (`FilterUISchema`); it is held serial behind this card.

`Clause-②: yes`: this narrows published exports, and the parent ruling's execution line declares `yes` on the same class. Narrowing alone would read `no` under the lane rule; `yes` is never wrong, and the `.changeset` prose owes an at-tier review regardless.

Why dispatch, not the director: the predecessor held this card for the director. This seat applies SKILL.md 升级与决策 meta-criterion ①: a same-family branch reuses the parent ruling and goes straight to the queue, unless there is a real semantic difference. The parent ruling extended the rule to `CommentEntry.recordId` / `MentionNotification.recordId` 「the same principle」, and these two sit beside them in the same file with the same spelling. The inheritance is bound to a premise that the dev tests first, and a falsified premise is reported as a fork, ⛔ not forced.
